{{Quote|The Hutts would slaughter us like criminals, when it is they who have taken what is not theirs.|Baratatta Spirit-Leader|<ref name="BigChief" />}}
The '''Baratatta Spirit-Leader''' was a [[Evocii]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the title of [[Spirit-Leader]] in the village of [[Baratatta]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. His wisdom was respected, even by the great Evocii warrior, [[Huttsbane]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You are a warrior. You must understand why we fight for our birthright.|The Spirit-Leader pleads with a bounty hunter to have mercy on Huttsbane|<ref name="BigChief" />}}
{{GameDS}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] was assigned by [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] to kill the Evocii warrior, Huttsbane. Upon arriving in Baratatta, the Hunter killed several insurgents, and finally confronted Huttsbane and the Spirit-Leader. The Spirit-Leader attempted to save Huttbane's life, explaining that the Hunter could take the head of another fallen Evocii instead of Huttsbane's, but the Hunter refused, and killed both Huttsbane and the Spirit-Leader in battle.<ref name="BigChief" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Here is the head of a fallen warrior. Nem'ro is a great fool. He will accept it as Huttsbane's. Now please, go.|The Spirit-Leader gives the Hunter the head of a fallen Evocii as a substitute for Huttsbane's|<ref name="BigChief" />}}
The player has the option of sparing both Huttsbane and the Spirit-Leader, and instead take the head of another Evocii to Nem'ro.<ref name="BigChief" />
